home.title: Fine Water in four practical sizes.
home.intro: Fine Water is purified bottled drinking water, available in 2 L, 1 L, 600 ml and 350 ml bottles. For orders, distribution and business inquiries, talk directly with Belema.
home.heroAlt: Abstract aqua water droplet above flowing water and layered mountain contours.
home.rangeIntro: Four sizes are listed on the current Fine Water range.
home.whyIntro: The facts here stay close to the information provided by Belema.
home.reason1Text: 2 L, 1 L, 600 ml and 350 ml bottles.
home.reason2Text: The current label lists a water analysis; the figures need confirmation against the latest laboratory report.
home.reason3Text: Use the published phone, WhatsApp or email details to discuss ordering and distribution.
home.tradeText: Belema General Trading PLC also handles import and export inquiries. Share your requirements to begin a conversation.
home.importText: Discuss sourcing, compliance, customs, logistics and delivery for your requested scope.
home.exportText: Ask about an export requirement. Goods, markets and available documentation are confirmed per inquiry.
home.certTitle: Certification details shown on the bottle label
home.certText: The label displays CES 99 LICENSE NO. 100532 and identifies the Ethiopian Conformity Assessment Enterprise. Confirm scope and current validity with the latest documents.
home.ctaTitle: What can we help you with?
home.ctaText: Contact Belema about Fine Water, distribution, importing or exporting.
home.contactStrip: Speak with Belema General Trading PLC

import.title: A clear conversation about your import requirement.
import.intro: Belema General Trading PLC handles import trade inquiries. Share the product scope and destination so the right next steps can be discussed.
import.servicesTitle: How an inquiry can move forward
import.servicesText: Specific goods, sourcing countries, compliance responsibilities, pricing and delivery terms are confirmed with you before any commitment.
import.categoryText: Categories have not yet been supplied. Please describe the product, specifications, origin and required quantity in your inquiry.
import.formText: Include the item or specification, quantity, origin, destination and timing you have in mind. No quote is created until Belema responds.

export.title: Discuss an export inquiry with Belema.
export.intro: Belema General Trading PLC welcomes export trade inquiries. The goods, target markets, supply availability and documentation are confirmed for each request.
export.goodsText: No export product categories or destination markets have been provided. Share the item, origin, destination and expected requirements so the scope can be reviewed.
export.documentsText: Documentation, customs responsibilities, shipment terms and logistics are discussed once the goods and destination are known.
export.formText: Describe the goods, target market, quantity and relevant dates. Belema will review the inquiry and follow up using your preferred contact details.

legal.privacyIntro: This draft explains the website’s intended contact-form and optional analytics behavior. It is not legal advice and must be reviewed and completed by Ethiopian counsel before production use.
legal.privacyContactText: When inquiry services are configured, the form sends the details you provide to Belema’s contact inbox so the company can respond. Do not include sensitive personal information. The website operator must set and disclose a retention period before launch.
legal.privacyAnalyticsText: Analytics are disabled unless configured. If enabled, the website asks for consent before loading analytics scripts; the final provider and disclosures must be confirmed in the production privacy notice.
legal.privacyRightsText: Contact Belema about a website inquiry or privacy request. The data controller, legal basis, retention period, and applicable request procedures require legal review.
legal.termsIntro: This draft is a starting point for review, not a final contract. Have Ethiopian counsel complete and approve it before production use.
legal.termsInfoText: Product-label data is presented as supplied and is flagged for confirmation against current documents. Availability, pricing, pack details, specifications, trade terms and delivery arrangements must be confirmed directly with Belema.
legal.termsInquiryText: Submitting a website inquiry is not an order, acceptance, quotation or contract. Any commercial commitment is subject to direct written confirmation by Belema.
legal.termsContactText: For questions about these draft terms, contact Belema using the configured email address. The governing law, company registration details, limitation terms and dispute process remain subject to counsel review.
legal.analyticsConsentText: Allow analytics scripts to load on this device? You can decline and still use the website.
